_help: The sections of the site, in dropdown/tile order. Each one is a page (<slug>.html). 'track' must match the 'track' column in portal_sources.csv. Optional: 'title_filter' (a name from TITLE_FILTERS in scripts/channels.py) keeps only matching video titles; 'window_days' overrides the 90-day window. Edit here, commit, and the GitHub Action rebuilds every page.
